parent.P28_R1_result: joint history GRU normal 35.917/reversed 36.042; joint conventional MLP normal 35.375/reversed 40.125; old-only frozen GRU + explicit XOR normal 193.25/reversed 193.167; 2frame 200

hypothesis: Can a small two-context continuous-output learned adapter infer actuator inversion solely from reward differences of actual executed CartPole interventions, preserving the original competent frozen token-free GRU and matching an equally informed conventional two-state contextual value table? No privileged physics/teacher action labels for the adapter.
null: Learned adapter cannot achieve both tasks at preset thresholds, fails to beat unadapted identity reverse control or wrong-credit negative, or is inferior to equally informed conventional empirical two-state reward table. Preserve all failures.

factual_source.physical_control: Old source-trained 608-update GRU (3 independent seeds) from P28 exactly; no retraining or gradients on the GRU
factual_source.policy_input: 8x6 factual past observed continuous sensor/action/reward, plus adapter-inferred selected-to-physical past action relabeling. Public velocity columns remain masked and task cue only enters 1-D adapter, NOT physical mapping oracle.
factual_source.factual_observation: The adapter learner sees only task cue (+1 original,-1 inverted) and total actual episode reward for each proposed action-mapping bit 0 or1. Source layer alone knows actual reversal and records chosen+physically executed actions for audit; no true reversal bit or privileged full-state teacher labels given to adapter.
factual_source.paired_actual_interventions: For each model init and task, both candidate mapping bits 0 and1 are run on two separately instantiated ORIGINAL MIT CartPole envs reset to the SAME training seed. Both execute actual physical actions and yield true source-observed consequences. Never infer fake counterfactual.

training.new_adapter_architecture: nn.Linear(1,1): 2 trainable scalar parameters, cue+1 or -1 -> probability of selecting inversion bit1; cold saved
training.training_algorithm: 32 epochs full-batch CPU AdamW logistic weighted BCE from only paired actual reward difference sign. Target=1 if realized reward mapping bit1>mapping bit0 else0, weight=abs(r1-r0)/200; zero-difference pairs ignored. This is reward-only evidence of action mapping, NOT general causal cognition.
training.reversed_control_negative: For wrong-credit logistic, exchange observed rewards of the two actually executed policy mapping trials, no synthetic rollouts.
training.conventional_baseline: Source-only reward table uses exact same observed paired training returns. Each context chooses mapping bit with higher empirical actual reward, no explicit original task mapping label.
training.cue_blind_negative: Same optimizer, training examples and reward targets but task cue collapsed to0; cannot encode two independent context mappings.

thresholds.conventional_table_not_beaten_claim: report rewards/cost on same paired data, superiority only if learned >=tabular+10 both contexts 2/3; impossible beyond 200 excluded
